content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

How many intercompany documents are not matched, and what is the total unmatched difference?

content.statement:
WITH __ic AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    difference_inr
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_IC_MATCHING
)
SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS documents,
  SUM(difference_inr) AS difference_inr
FROM __ic
WHERE
  status <> 'MATCHED'
GROUP BY
  status
ORDER BY
  difference_inr DESC
